notes: Datasheet covers GPON OLT application classes B+, C+, C++, and D with class-specific mean launched power, sensitivity, and overload. LG-SC432G-20CB1 ordering specifies 0°C to +70°C; LG-SC432G-20IB1 specifies -40°C to +85°C (Industrial operating case also listed under Recommended Operating Conditions). Tx bit rate 2.488 Gbps and Rx 1.244 Gbps in tables; title/ordering also state 2.5 Gbps and 1.25 Gbps. Sensitivity and overload conditions: PRBS223-1 @ 1.244G, ER=10, BER<10^-10 or BER<10^-4 as labeled per row. Transmitter and dispersion penalty max 1 dB stated without a paired penalized parameter value at a defined condition. Mean launched power (TX Off) max -45 dBm. Spectral width (-20 dB) max 1 nm. Receiver burst mode dynamic range 15 dB. WDM filter isolation to 1550 nm 38 dB and to 1650 nm 35 dB. Power supply current max 500 mA at 3.3 V (power in W not stated).
suggestions: Consider schema fields for GPON OLT class (B+/C+/C++/D), burst-mode dynamic range, WDM filter isolation, spectral width (-20 dB), and TX-off launched power. Transmitter and dispersion penalty may need a rule when only max penalty dB is given without @ conditions.
